description: The document as a file: docx (Word), md, html or mrdoc for documents; xlsx (Excel), csv or mrsheet for spreadsheets; pptx (PowerPoint) or mrslides for presentations. Word, Excel and PowerPoint files are written by MR Office's engine and need the person signed in (sign_in). Returns the file and a download link for the person.
name: export_document
title: Export a document
